title: CTS Congregational Church Government and Baptist Polity — Unit 6: Origin, Name, and Qualifications

en: Unit 1 - Christ the Head: Biblical Foundations of Church Government

Unit 7 - The Deacon Office II: Duties, Ministry to the Needy, Support of the Pastor, and Finances
Unit 8 - The Deacon Family Ministry Plan

Unit 10 - Business Meetings, Constitutions, Bylaws, Property, and the Law

stem.en: Which Greek word is the source of the English word "deacon"?

en: Diakonos, a servant who waits on others at the table
Presbuteros, an older man who rules by right of age
Episkopos, an overseer who directs the congregation
Apostolos, a sent one who has seen the risen Lord
